## Change

Explain the engineering impact and affected records.

## Evidence

Link primary sources. For UPDATE, include parent ID and the material change.
For REVIEW, include the stored dedupeReview rationale.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m radar validate` passes
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -v` passes
- [ ] `python -m radar rollup --check` passes
- [ ] Story and observation history is appended; past rows remain intact
- [ ] No unverified metrics or unsupported adoption claims
